title: FastContext
content:
The FastContext is a pooled resource designed to minimize memory allocation per request. It utilizes a Lazy Parsing strategy and a Deep-Reset Protocol to ensure minimal garbage collection overhead.

Deep-Reset Protocol

Unlike traditional frameworks that create new request objects, Photon's engine recycles context objects. The Deep-Reset protocol explicitly nullifies internal references and resets the state machine in O(1) time, preventing memory leaks and keeping the JIT compiler optimized for monomorphic access patterns.

High-Performance Input Access

app.get('/api/search/:category', (c) => {
  // 1. Path Parameters (Pre-parsed by router)
  const category = c.req.param('category')

  // 2. Query Strings (Lazy-parsed on first access)
  const query = c.req.query('q')

  // 3. Headers (Case-insensitive lookup)
  const userAgent = c.req.header('User-Agent')

  return c.json({ category, query, userAgent })
})

Standard Responses

Return high-speed responses using optimized helpers:

  • c.json(data): High-speed serialization.
  • c.text(str): Zero-copy string response.
  • c.html(html): Server-side rendering support.
